blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur — The National Irrigation Administration Region 9 (Zamboanga Peninsula) has instructed its personnel to implement crop diversification strategies and administrative reforms to cushion farmers from the effects of the El Niño phenomenon. Engr. June Nathaniel Plaza, NIA-9 regional manager, on Monday urged personnel to take proactive measures to help farmers diversify their food sources and income amid dry conditions. “A hero is not always someone in a position of power, but can be any person who helps improve the lives of others,” Plaza said, urging employees to use their official positions to assist agricultural workers rather […]...
